pretreatments.description: Mechanical milling of food waste using a food grinder.
Pulverization of air-dried Enteromorpha to approximately 0.25 mm using a hammer mill.

Hydrothermal pretreatment (HTP) conducted in a stainless-steel autoclave reactor at temperatures of 50, 80, 110, or 140 °C for 20 min with a total volatile solids concentration of 30 g VS·L^−1 and moisture content set at 90%.
Addition of pulverized oyster shells (less than 0.21 mm) at 8% (w/w) of total dry weight of food waste and Enteromorpha.
